Hi Sana —

Great to meet earlier. Quick recap and next steps from our discovery call so we can lock the technical deep dive: 

- Goal: walk the MedStream engineering + platform teams through a 60-minute technical deep dive (architecture, latency profiles, data flow controls, and rollout plan).
- Proposed duration: 60 minutes (45 min demo + 15 min Q&A).
- Pre-reads: I attached a one-page MAP (Mutual Action Plan) and a draft agenda for your review.

Can you confirm the core engineering attendees and which time slot below works best for your team? Also let us know if you prefer Google Meet (recommended for org SSO) or Zoom.

Proposed slots (PDT):
1) Tue 8/25 10:00–11:00
2) Wed 8/26 14:00–15:00
3) Thu 8/27 09:00–10:00

If none of those work, share a couple windows and we’ll adjust. Once you confirm, I’ll send a single consolidated calendar invite with the agenda and Meet link and include the internal presenters from our side.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
